short_name: CKD: Uncoded - two low eGFRs with no recorded CKD (CVDP002CKD)
full_description: Patients whose last two eGFRs are less than 60ml/min/1.73m2 (uncoded CKD), who do not have a record of GP recorded CKD (G3a to G5)

short_name: Hypertension: High risk – one high BP with no recorded hypertension (CVDP005HYP)
full_description: Patients with single blood pressure reading of systolic >=140mmHg and diastolic >=90mmHg (at risk of hypertension), who do not have a record of GP recorded hypertension
Patients with GP recorded chronic kidney disease (G3a to G5), who are currently treated with lipid lowering therapy.
Patients with GP recorded CVD or CVD risk factors who are GP recorded current smokers or have no smoking status recorded, whose notes record smoking status in the preceding 12 months.

short_name: NDH: High risk – one HbA1c 42-48 mmol/mol, with no recorded NDH or DM (CVDP002NDH)
full_description: Patients whose last HbA1c record is between 42 and 48 mmol/mol (at high risk of NDH), without a GP record of non-diabetic hyperglycaemia or diabetes mellitus.
Patients with GP recorded hypertension, with a record of a urine ACR test in the preceding 12 months.
Patients with GP recorded atrial fibrillation and with a CHADS2 or CHA2DS2-VASc score of 2 or more, who are currently treated with any oral anticoagulant.

short_name: CKD: High risk - one low eGFR with no recorded CKD (CVDP003CKD)
full_description: Patients whose last single eGFR is less than 60ml/min/1.73m2 (at risk of CKD), who do not have a record of GP recorded CKD (G3a to G5)
Patients with GP recorded CVD or CVD risk factors who are GP recorded current smokers, who have a record of an offer of support or treatment within the preceding 12 months.

short_name: DM: Uncoded - two high HbA1c with no recorded diabetes (CVDP003DM)
full_description: Patients whose last two HbA1c records are 48mmol/mol or more (uncoded diabetes), who do not have a GP record of diabetes.
Patients with GP recorded CVD (narrow definition), who are currently treated with lipid lowering therapy.
Patients with GP recorded hypertension, with a record of a blood pressure reading in the preceding 12 months.
Patients with no GP recorded CVD and a GP recorded QRISK score of 10% or more, who are currently treated with lipid lowering therapy

short_name: DM: High risk - one high HbA1c with no recorded diabetes (CVDP005DM)
full_description: Patients whose last single HbA1c record is 48 mmol/mol or more (possible diabetes), who do not have a GP record of diabetes or have uncoded diabetes.
Patients with no GP recorded CVD and a GP recorded QRISK score of 20% or more, who are currently treated with lipid lowering therapy
Patients with GP recorded CKD (G3a to G5) with a record of a urine ACR test in the preceding 12 months
Patients with GP recorded CKD (G3a to G5), with a record of an eGFR test in the preceding 12 months.

short_name: Hypertension: Treated to appropriate threshold (all ages) (CVDP007HYP)
full_description: Patients with GP recorded hypertension, whose last blood pressure reading is to the appropriate treatment threshold, in the preceding 12 months.
Patients with GP recorded hypertension aged under 80, whose last blood pressure reading is to the appropriate treatment threshold, in the preceding 12 months.

short_name: CKD: High risk treated with RAS antagonists (CVDP005CKD)
full_description: Patients with GP recorded CKD (G3a to G5) and hypertension and proteinuria, who are currently treated with renin-angiotensin system antagonists
Patients with GP recorded hypertension aged 80 and over, whose last blood pressure reading is to the appropriate treatment threshold, in the preceding 12 months.

short_name: CKD: ACR < 70mg/mmol treated to appropriate BP threshold (CVDP007CKD)
full_description: Patients with GP recorded CKD (G3a to G5) with an ACR of less than 70 mg/mmol, whose last blood pressure reading is to the appropriate treatment threshold.

short_name: Cholesterol: Primary prevention of CVD treated with LLT (CVDP008CHOL)
full_description: Patients with no GP recorded CVD and either a GP recorded QRISK score of 10% or more, or CKD or high risk diabetes, who are currently treated with lipid lowering therapy.
Patients with GP recorded hypertension, prescribed at least one anti-hypertensive treatment with low systolic blood pressure and a subsequent antihypertensive medication prescription date
Patients with GP recorded CVD or CVD risk factors, with GP recorded body mass index status in the preceding 12 months.
Patients with GP recorded heart failure, with a record of an eGFR test in the preceding 6 months.
Patients with GP recorded coronary heart disease (CHD), whose last blood pressure reading is to the appropriate treatment threshold, in the preceding 12 months.
Patients with GP recorded stroke or transient ischaemic attack, whose last blood pressure reading is to the appropriate treatment threshold, in the preceding 12 months.

short_name: AF: Low risk AF with recorded CHA2DS2-VASc score (CVDP004AF)
full_description: Patients with GP recorded atrial fibrillation and with a CHADS2 or CHA2DS2-VASc score of less than 2 or no CHADS2 or CHA2DS2-VASc score, whose stroke risk has been assessed using the CHA2DS2-VASc scoring system in the preceding 12 months.

short_name: AF: Treated with anticoagulants - DOAC prioritised (CVDP005AF)
full_description: Patients with GP recorded atrial fibrillation and with a CHADS2 or CHA2DS2-VASc score of  2 or more, who are currently treated with a direct-acting oral anticoagulant or vitamin K antagonist.
Patients with GP recorded CVD (narrow definition), with a record of a non-HDL or LDL cholesterol test in the preceding 12 months.

short_name: Cholesterol: CVD treated to cholesterol threshold (CVDP012CHOL)
full_description: Patients with GP recorded CVD (narrow definition), whose most recent blood cholesterol level is LDL-cholesterol less than or equal to 2.0 mmol/l or non-HDL  cholesterol less than or equal to 2.6 mmol/l, in the preceding 12 months
